dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Nara friend spare <color=#00E1FFFF>a shriveled Starshroom</color> for Aranara? And <color=#00E1FFFF>a Viparyas</color> too, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Want <color=#00E1FFFF>a Viparyas and shriveled Starshroom</color>. Normal ones have normal purposes, shriveled ones have shriveled purposes.

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Shriveled Starshrooms can be very useful too. Thank you, Nara friend.

dialogues.speaker: Material-Collecting Aranara
dialogues.text: Time to get back to Vanarana... Golden Nara should visit too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What was that thing that looked like a vegetable?
